title: SorraStaking — Staking Reward Calculation Bug Analysis
root_cause: During staking reward calculation, only the block timestamp was updated while the block number was not, causing accumulated reward errors on repeated withdrawals
steps: block number not updated → reward recalculation overpays
→ [4] Accumulated SOR tokens → swapped to ETH via Uniswap V2
other_code:
Attacker
  │
  ├─→ [1] Deposit ~122 billion SOR tokens (tier 0)
  │
  ├─→ [2] vm.warp(+14 days) — simulate 14-day elapsed time
  │
  ├─→ [3] withdraw(1) × 800 repeated calls
  │         └─ each call resets only the timestamp
  │            block number not updated → reward recalculation overpays
  │
  ├─→ [4] Accumulated SOR tokens → swapped to ETH via Uniswap V2
  │
  └─→ [5] ~8 ETH obtained
